name: big-quote-full
description: 全屏大引言：单句占满画面（4.5vh 级别的呼吸感）
css: #tpl-big-quote-full { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 8vw; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); } .bq-text { font-size: 5.6vh; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); max-width: 84%; } .bq-src { font-size: 2vh; opacity: .6; margin-top: 4vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); }
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .bq-text", { opacity: 0, y: 50 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: "power2.out" }, {start} + 0.1);tl.fromTo("{tpl} .bq-src", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.5 }, {start} + 0.9);
